sourceAccessNotes: Hotchkiss civil Jeep details were available in indexed Club Hotchkiss search excerpts; direct page subsequently returned403.
Original period brochures/engineering tables were not downloaded for a full technical trim inventory. Club catalogue transcriptions, museum records and FIA identity data are explicitly scoped.
The contemporary innocenti.com archive was inspected as a lead, but its technical simulations and contradictory corporate/history claims were not used as configuration evidence.
